categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Matches the 'Private Broadcast' label hint and directly addresses transaction origin privacy on the P2P network.
categories.rationale: Resolves a privacy leak where wallet rebroadcasts identify the node as the origin over clearnet despite `-privatebroadcast`. As noted in the commit, holding and serving an evicted transaction that no other peer holds 'marks it as the node's own,' undermining the core privacy objective of private broadcast.

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Changes wallet resubmission logic in src/wallet/wallet.cpp and src/wallet/wallet.h, and carries the 'Wallet' label.
categories.rationale: Prevents the wallet from undermining user privacy expectations by suppressing periodic resubmissions of unconfirmed transactions under `-privatebroadcast`. Leaving this unresolved allows unexpected wallet rebroadcasts (such as incoming dust payments) to trigger clearnet announcements.
